tools.name: about
tools.title: About Keyfleet
tools.description: Read the About page as Markdown: what Keyfleet is and does, how it differs, who uses it, the team, key facts, common questions and who runs it. Reads only; needs no sign-in; changes nothing.

tools.name: docs
tools.title: Developer documentation
tools.description: Read the developer documentation as Markdown: the open fleet directory, signing in as an agent, the signed agent requests and the account requests. Use it before calling the HTTP API. Reads only; needs no sign-in; changes nothing.

tools.name: mark_present
tools.title: Mark keys present
tools.description: Press this page's Mark present: marks present for 48 hours every key the wallet holds, or holds an active shard of while the key's agent voting is on. A key present when a proposal opens is counted in its vote. Needs sign-in and a wallet on your account open; the wallet asks the person to approve the transaction, and the network fee is paid from it.

tools.name: propose
tools.title: Propose
tools.description: Fill this page's proposal form with these fields and press Propose: opens a vote of every key on what the proposal does. Fields left out keep what the form shows. Needs sign-in and a wallet on your account open; the wallet asks the person to approve the transaction, and the network fee is paid from it.

key.description: The number of the key it is made with: one the wallet holds, or holds a shard of while the key's agent voting is on.

text.description: The proposal's words, up to 4,000 bytes. They are kept on Keyfleet; the chain holds their fingerprint.

asset.description: pay and advance: the address of the asset paid, one the page offers.

amount.description: pay and advance: the amount in whole tokens.

recipient.description: pay and advance: the address paid.

rate.description: rate: the daily split in percent, 0.1 to 2.

target.description: edits: the number of the key whose edits change.

restricted.description: edits: "true" restricts the key's edits, "false" allows them.

signature.description: signature: "approve" signs the message for the fleet, "revoke" withdraws the signature.

tools.name: run_split
tools.title: Run the daily split
tools.description: Press this page's Run split: shares each asset at or above its minimum, its balance times the rate, equally across every key sold. Anyone may, 24 hours after the last run; the split preview on the page shows what it shares. Needs sign-in and a wallet on your account open; the wallet asks the person to approve the transaction, and the network fee is paid from it.

tools.name: vote
tools.title: Vote
tools.description: Press one of this proposal's vote buttons: votes with every key the wallet holds, or holds an active shard of while the key's agent voting is on. Voting again changes the vote until voting closes. Needs sign-in and a wallet on your account open; the wallet asks the person to approve the transaction, and the network fee is paid from it.

tools.name: cancel_proposal
tools.title: Cancel proposal
tools.description: Press this proposal's Cancel proposal: cancels it while it is open or approved. Whoever may vote the key it was made with may cancel it. Needs sign-in and a wallet on your account open; the wallet asks the person to approve the transaction, and the network fee is paid from it.

tools.name: carry_out
tools.title: Carry it out
tools.description: Press this proposal's Carry it out: makes exactly the calls the proposal shows. Anyone may, once it is approved and voting has closed, for 48 hours. Needs sign-in and a wallet on your account open; the wallet asks the person to approve the transaction, and the network fee is paid from it.

tools.name: claim
tools.title: Claim
tools.description: Press one of the open key's Claim buttons: claims what the daily split shared with the key in one asset. It is always paid to the key's holder. Needs sign-in and a wallet on your account open; the wallet asks the person to approve the transaction, and the network fee is paid from it.

asset.description: The address of the asset to claim, one the key's Claim buttons name.
